collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-12  -  THE SMALLER VOICE SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: During a village discussion, a young teenager notices that an elderly villager with a soft voice cannot make themselves heard.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a village discussion, a young teenager notices that an elderly villager with a soft voice cannot make themselves heard.

choices.label: Ask the Group to Pause and Listen.
Move Closer and Offer to Repeat the Elder's Words.
Suggest Speaking One at a Time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The elder declines to speak further but appreciates the consideration.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: With permission, the teenager helps the group hear the suggestion accurately.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The elder prefers to speak independently, and the teenager makes room instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The conversation becomes calmer, allowing several people to participate.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some villagers continue interrupting, and the discussion leader must reinforce the arrangement.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The teenager learns that the elder had an important concern left unaddressed.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The elder says they were content to listen but appreciates being noticed.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The elder shares a practical suggestion that changes the discussion.

a1__text.text: The elder shares a practical suggestion that changes the discussion.
